mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, description, status, start_date, end_date FROM project ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'ACTIVE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, id DESC
SELECT id, code, name, description, status, start_date, end_date FROM project WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project (code, name, description, status, start_date, end_date) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{description}, #{status}, #{startDate}, #{endDate})
INSERT INTO project_member (project_id, user_id, project_role) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{userId}, #{projectRole})
mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.name, u.role, pm.project_role FROM project_member pm JOIN users u ON u.id = pm.user_id WHERE pm.project_id = #{projectId} AND u.enabled = TRUE ORDER BY u.name
